gloss: to tie, to bind, to form

definitions.explanation: To fasten or secure with a knot.
To establish a connection or reach an agreement.

notes:
{結|むす}ぶ is a transitive godan verb meaning "to tie" or "to form/conclude."

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pair: {結|むす}ばれる (passive/intransitive - to be tied, connected)

CONCRETE USES:
- {靴|くつ}ひもを{結|むす}ぶ: to tie shoelaces
- {髪|かみ}を{結|むす}ぶ: to tie one's hair
- リボンを{結|むす}ぶ: to tie a ribbon

ABSTRACT USES:
- {契約|けいやく}を{結|むす}ぶ: to conclude a contract
- {友情|ゆうじょう}を{結|むす}ぶ: to form a friendship
- {条約|じょうやく}を{結|むす}ぶ: to sign a treaty

IDIOM:
- {実|み}を{結|むす}ぶ: to bear fruit (efforts come to fruition)
